strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor on this short, demanding National layout. Managing those tires through the Motodrom will be crucial.
With such a short lap, the pit window is tight. A perfectly executed stop is essential to avoid losing valuable track position.
Fuel consumption will be less of a concern on the National layout compared to the full circuit, allowing teams to run a more aggressive engine map.
The shorter lap also means more laps overall, increasing the chances of a safety car period. Teams need to be ready to react quickly.
Overtaking opportunities are limited, so qualifying position is even more critical on this National layout.
The balance between straight-line speed and cornering grip is key here. A compromised setup could cost valuable time.
With only 2.638km per lap, even a small mistake can have a significant impact on the overall race time.
The Querspange chicane is crucial to get right – too aggressive and you risk damage, too cautious and you lose time.
